author: cli
text: Re-read at 0.55.5. The module docstring and the 'Fallback only - the installed distribution's metadata is authoritative' comment are both still exact. Flagged for the same reason as last release: the version literal moved 0.55.4 -> 0.55.5, which shifts the module's logic hash while its comments stay correct. Worth recording that this very literal is the one that caused the project's longest-lived flake - a same-length bump landing in the same second as a .pyc write left the import cache serving the old string. Fixed in this release by making the version test read the FILE rather than the imported module; the comment here needed no change.
